ledger.x: 1258: the Mongols set up Ssangseong Prefecture in Goryeo's north-east.

wars.name: Gongmin's reconquest of Ssangseong
wars.outcome: Goryeo under King Gongmin retakes Ssangseong, with Yu Inu.

certainty.note: The page gives a pass, a county and prefectures, no boundary; the Cheollyeong Pass line is the only edge it names.
